name: web-fatis-the-solution-banner-with-faded-laptop-heart-sketch
title: 'The Solution' banner mirrored: faded pink laptop, heart and rising arrow sketch on the left
whatItIs: A wide beige banner mirroring 'The Problem': a faded pink sketch of a laptop with a donut, a heart, sparkles, a cursor and a rising arrow on the left, and a hot pink 'The Solution' heading and paragraph on the right.
whatItMeans: Uplifting and paired; mirroring the layout tells the reader this answers the problem.
techniques: Mirror the problem layout for the solution.
Swap worried motifs for hearts and rising arrows.
Keep both banners in the same palette.

vocabulary.definition: A layout flipped left to right to pair two ideas.
Repeating a structure to link two sections.
